production.direction_en: At a fork in the stair, companions who escorted refugees return from the outer route. They do not replace the player's formation; they create a brief, scripted diversion while the five-person party advances.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_held_the_road — full ensemble statement | post: bgm_held_the_road (comic tag for the barricade line)

commands.speaker: brin_alder
commands.text: The refugees are through. I told the guards to bar the road behind us.

commands.speaker: rikka_ember
commands.text: And I told them the barricade was my idea. They believed me because I looked proud of it.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: Two sentinels are winding up a flank attack. Mahmut, your left side is about to become very popular.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You have already done enough. Get everyone home.

commands.speaker: brin_alder
commands.text: Then come back so I can tell you that in person.
